Description: Gap, displacement, reaction, residual, tolerance, and friction values are represented as raw f64 fields; the API does not carry explicit unit identifiers, declared unit-system references, or explicit dimensionless classification for friction coefficient.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: nonlinear_supports now exposes NonlinearSupportUnitMetadata for caller-supplied displacement, reaction force, and dimensionless friction-coefficient unit metadata; README documents metadata-only behavior and no conversion/defaulting. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/nonlinear_supports/Cargo.toml passed 10 tests on 2026-05-16.

Description: Missing trial-state and missing friction-data conditions are explicit Rust errors, but they are not yet carried through the canonical diagnostic/result-envelope fields required for downstream status, provenance, remediation, and report disclosure.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: nonlinear missing-data and numeric errors now map to SolverDiagnostic records with class/remediation/provenance support supplied by the diagnostics crate, while preserving the active-set mechanics API. Evidence: nonlinear_missing_data_errors_map_to_solver_diagnostics passed in cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/nonlinear_supports/Cargo.toml on 2026-05-16.
